snippet.title: The all-knowing lie detector | Chris & Jack
snippet.description:
A detective grills a suspect. Will this interrogation lead to a huge confession? Or will a liar get away with -- wait, actually... what's going on with this polygraph machine? It seems to be some sort of vessel for universal truths.  It holds the answers to every question. Hold that thought about the criminal stuff. Time to ask about teleportation, the meaning of life, and lotto numbers. 

Outtakes, deleted scenes, director commentary and so much more up on our Patreon: https://www.patreon.com/chrisandjack

Watch our most popular sketches! https://youtube.com/playlist?list=PLSpZLcBI3iW8UuwB6O3FwEYh6XxfvC1By&si=SEhfz3BDucMkV17J&playnext=1  

We're Chris W. Smith and Jack De Sena (aka Chris & Jack). We've been friends for years and love making high-quality, high-concept sketch comedy. Chris is an occasional Blue Man in Blue Man Group. As a voice actor, Jack played Sokka in Avatar the Last Airbender and Callum in the Dragon Prince. In 2016 we united to create this channel, confusingly titled “Chris & Jack”, which has served as a shared platform to write, produce, direct, edit, and star in our own stuff. We're releasing comedic sketches of all shapes and sizes. Sci-Fi, Heists, animation, movie tropes, fantasy, absurdist bits, and plenty of fun new experiments. But above all else, friendship.  

A huge thank you to all our Patrons, including our "Producer Tier" friends:

snippet.title: BURRÃO E A CORRUPÇÃO | EMBRULHA PRA VIAGEM
snippet.description:
“Burrão e a corrupção” nos mostra que a corrupção está muito mais próxima do que imaginamos, e não é só uma prática de políticos. Às vezes, é praticada  por algumas empresas que forçam o funcionário a pagar a despesa do próprio bolso, demora um tempão para reembolsa-ló, só para ganhar juros em cima dele. Ou de alguns funcionários espertinhos que adoram pedir nota com valor acima do consumo, só para ganhar em cima da empresa. Ou seja, a corrupção está ao nosso lado e cabe a nós dar o exemplo no nosso dia-a-dia.
